metadata.description: gon2gon2's agent skills, packaged as plugins.

plugins.name: orca-workflows
plugins.description: Workflows that run coding agents through Orca. rather-than-me sends one brief to frontier models made by other AI labs, collects their independent reviews and compares them with its own view. issue-autopilot sets up a scheduled Orca automation that implements a repo's GitHub issues one at a time from a runbook, each in a fresh worktree ending in a PR. orca-setup audits how you use Orca and applies setup changes one approved item at a time: bundled skills, worktree rules for your agent instructions, a hook that blocks `git worktree remove` on Orca worktrees, and orca.yaml shared directories. adopt-pet turns your own character art into an Orca pet: a .codex-pet bundle whose animations follow your agents' state, with rows you have no art for filled in, validated against Orca's import rules. Works from Claude Code and Codex. Requires Orca.

plugins.name: dev-practices
plugins.description: Practices for building agent skills. deterministic-sandwich moves every deterministic step of a skill into a script so the LLM makes exactly one natural-language judgment.
